rule: Doc-only declaration of the CI guards that MUST be wired in a later step. This manifest does NOT install, activate, register, or run any guard. No script paths under scripts/ci-guards/ are mutated by authoring this file. The doc/spec lives here so the next step can lift each guard from this declaration into scripts/ci-guards/dos-master-gate.mjs without re-deriving requirements.

outOfScope: executing any guard against a real branch

guards.summary: Every v1.1 contract file carries the v1 surface PLUS the new operating layers. No $ref to v1, no missing v1 fields.
guards.rationale: v1 pack is frozen as historical archive. The resolver loads v1.1 only. If any v1.1 file points to v1, regeneration is incomplete.
mustFailOn: $ref values targeting dogan_shahin_all_contracts_v1_runtime/
missing carriedForwardFromV1 markers in workspace/product contracts
module contract file count != 24
any v1.1 contract missing contractKind/contractVersion/runtimeModel
expectedPassEvidence: every contractVersion equals '1.1.0'
every runtimeModel equals 'v1-1-operating-runtime'
modules directory contains all 24 module codes listed in platform contract

guards.summary: Bidirectional manifest <-> SQL match. Each blocker entry has a paired SQL file with matching SHA-256 checksum, idempotency markers, and consistent destructive flag.
guards.rationale: B1, B2, B3, B4 must not drift between machine-readable manifest and human-reviewable SQL. A typo in either side is a doctrine breach (DB-first principle).
mustFailOn: blocker_id present in manifest but missing SQL file
SQL file present but missing blocker_id in manifest
sql_checksum mismatch
non-idempotent SQL (no IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT / DO block check)
destructive flag inconsistent between manifest and SQL DDL semantics
B2 SQL using generic replace(item_id, '-', '.') instead of explicit VALUES map
B1 SQL omitting tenant_id from unique index expression
B3 SQL using ADD CONSTRAINT IF NOT EXISTS instead of pg_constraint guarded DO block
B4 SQL not marked review_required = true
expectedPassEvidence: manifest contains exactly 4 entries (B1, B2, B3, B4)
preflight/migrations/ contains exactly 4 .sql files
every sql_checksum in manifest matches sha256sum of the SQL file
preflight/lockstep.proof.json populated with one row per blocker

guards.summary: Every contract field across all 6 runtimes has at least one entry in publication-map/db-publication.map.v1-1.json. Zero orphans.
guards.rationale: If a contract field has no DB publication target, the resolver cannot emit it from DB. Hidden fallbacks would be the only way to populate it.
mustFailOn: envelope field with no entry in db-publication.map.v1-1.json
publication entry with no envelope field reference
publication entry without table/columns/primaryKey
publication entry missing tenantScope when envelope is tenant-scoped
publication entry missing idempotencyRule
publication entry that uses replace(...,'-','.') for normalizationRule (must be explicit map)
expectedPassEvidence: publication.lockstep.json envelopeFieldsTotal equals union of envelope fields
every envelopeField in lockstep has a publishedFrom pointer that resolves
every preflightDependency on db-publication.map points to a valid blocker_id

guards.summary: Every envelope file is referenced by at least one contract (publishedBy) and at least one consumption-map entry (runtimeEnvelope or secondaryEnvelopes).
guards.rationale: An orphan envelope means the resolver shape has nothing producing it or nothing consuming it. Either case violates DB->Resolver->Frontend doctrine.
mustFailOn: envelope file with publishedBy not pointing to an existing contract
envelope file with no consumption-map component referencing it
consumption-map component referencing an envelope file that does not exist
consumption-map referencing v1 envelope path
expectedPassEvidence: 6 envelope files (workspace, product, module, tenant, integration, theme)
every envelope has at least one consumption-map consumer
every consumption-map consumer references at least one envelope

guards.summary: Preflight SQL files are NOT imported, referenced, or executed by scripts/migrate.* or scripts/module/publish.mjs. They are review-only artifacts in this step.
guards.rationale: Per plan boundary, no DB execution in this step. Auto-wiring B1..B4 into the migrator pipeline is forbidden until human review approves each preflight SQL.
mustFailOn: any reference to platform/ui-system/dos-ui-system/dogan_shahin_all_contracts_v1_1_operating_runtime/preflight/migrations/*.sql in migrator entry points
any include/import of preflight SQL paths in publish pipeline
any duplicate file copy of preflight SQL into platform/dos/migrations/public/
expectedPassEvidence: scripts/migrate.* contains zero hits for the preflight migration filenames
scripts/module/publish.mjs contains zero hits for the preflight migration filenames
platform/dos/migrations/public/ does not contain duplicate copies of B1..B4 SQL

guards.summary: Consumption map has zero hardcoded labels/routes/icons left as 'allowed' bindings. Every binding resolves to a runtime envelope field. Every hardcodedSymbolsToPurge.replaceWith points to an envelope field, not another literal.
guards.rationale: If the consumption map itself smuggles a literal as the replacement, the doctrine is broken at the contract layer.
mustFailOn: any allowedReads entry that does not start with shell.|productRuntime.|moduleRuntime.|tenantRuntime.|integrationRuntime.|themeRuntime.
any replaceWith string that contains a hex color, a quoted route literal like '/...'/'@/...', a 'DOS Platform' literal, or a numeric pixel literal
any reference to v1 (non-v1-1) envelope path
any component without a carbonRendererClass field
any component without breakpointBindings (use [] if intentionally none) or themeBindings
expectedPassEvidence: components count >= 13
every component has runtimeEnvelope set
every hardcodedSymbolsToPurge.replaceWith starts with a runtime envelope path
globalForbiddenReads contains the localStorage / subdomain / window.* / process.env clauses

wiringSpec.addStep: All 6 guards above are added in a SINGLE later commit, in the order listed. The master gate must short-circuit on the first failing guard.
wiringSpec.execution: Each guard is implemented as scripts/ci-guards/lint-v1-1-<guardId-suffix>.mjs and emits its outputArtifact under proofs/foundation-ai/post-launch/v1-1/.

summary.outOfScopeNote: This file declares; it does not execute. The next step ports each entry into scripts/ci-guards/ and wires the master gate.

acceptance: guards array contains exactly 6 entries with the canonical guardIds
every guard declares scanScope, mustFailOn, expectedPassEvidence, outputArtifact
no script under scripts/ci-guards/ is created or modified by authoring this manifest
no entry in scripts/migrate.* or scripts/module/publish.mjs is mutated
lockstepArtifacts list matches the two existing lockstep JSON files in the pack
